apk.nativeInstallScope: Native installation and play observations, with tested APK hash, are recorded separately in manual-verification.json.

scope: Extracted Korean data and 24,737 script instructions
Original-function differential fixtures for dice, new-game placement, navigation, supplies, combat, economics and script arithmetic
Independent navigation, trading, supply/unloading, shipyard, recruitment, appointments, equipment, contracts, gambling, battle, spoils and save/restore
Six original story endings with test-supplied travel, fame and battle prerequisites
Seven royal quest families, debt collection and actual A* sea travel
All 130 port arrivals and 889 building paths
Real-time battle movement, projectiles, ammunition, fleet AI, flagship duel and deterministic save/restore
Atomic game editor, speaker and attendant portraits, fleet hail reply and sea camera bounds
limits: Tests of story endings supply progression prerequisites; these are not six complete human playthroughs.
NPC global routing and offscreen combat use independent pathfinding and scheduling; they are not instruction-identical to the DOS runtime.
Original-function comparisons validate recorded inputs only, not every possible game state.
All 101 town layouts were reviewed in an overview gallery; exhaustive dialogue and form bounds were checked in a browser harness. This does not cover every device.
Versioned release validation records the exact browser and Android observations and their limits.

observations: Updated the existing independent app to 1.0.6 and observed the version on its title screen.
Opened all save slots and restored the existing automatic save: Joao, Ceuta, 4 June 1522 09:00, 34 gold, 15 crew. The pub rendered correctly. No manual save slot was overwritten.
At 844x390, fired a real simulated shell and inspected its smoke/trail during flight; ammunition fell 40 to 39.
Inspected the actual hit at 0.7 seconds: enemy hull 200 to 199, explosion, smoke, sparks and damage label. QA paused the simulation for these screenshots.
Tapped open water to set a fixed crosshair, then held Down+Space: the ship turned and moved while firing, ammunition reached 38.
Entered a duel by approaching the marked flagship. Checked character wind-up, thrust/slash, defence, damage and disabled controls during animation.
Played the duel through 20 exchanges and observed return to active sea battle.
Viewed the graphical duel in both landscape and portrait, with both full figures and action buttons visible.
Console error list was empty in the final QA tab.
browser.method: Actual application code and UI interactions; QA battle fixtures initialize a known scene and are not included in the APK.

limits: Native Android testing covered update installation and restoring an existing save. The combat/duel interactions were tested in the browser, not on a physical phone.
Screen audits check geometry and control reachability; they are not a manual reading of all 4302 dialogues.
Full campaigns were not manually replayed. Generated duel bodies use male/female archetypes; the identity portraits are character-specific.
